request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They brought the children to Jesus
That he might touch them and bless
The disciples told them to go away
But Jesus said, no, let them stay

[Chorus]
Let the children come to me
Do not hinder them
For to such belongs the kingdom of God
Let the children come

[Verse]
He took them up into his arms
And laid his hands on them
Whoever does not receive the kingdom
Like a child shall not enter in

[Chorus]
Let the children come to me
Do not hinder them
For to such belongs the kingdom of God
Let the children come
